g.text: Boulders 3 and 4 do not isolate a stable endpoint
by 450–510 °C; their arcs are fitted as great circles
(orange) and combined with the resolved lines
mean → lines + planes mean. Both boulders move
toward the northerly, shallow cluster, so R rises
from 5.31 to 6.09 and the fail is strengthened.
